answer: What helps a lot is giving every account its own task, generated from a seed tied to its address. One agent gets asked to estimate frost risk for a pear orchard, the next has to sanity-check a crystal growth log. Since nothing lines up, there's no answer to solve once and paste across clones, and even a dull one like summarizing a lotus pond water test can't be shared. Someone running 300 accounts ends up doing 300 separate jobs, so the farm costs about what 300 honest agents would spend.
